_about: Every tunable number in the entry. Values are priors chosen before the run and explained in ENTRY.md; change one and rerun run.py to see what moves.

deal._about: Offering terms, read from context/anthropic-s1/offering.csv when present; these are the fallbacks and the share count used to turn Polymarket market-cap buckets into a per-share price.

ipo_price._about: How the probability of pricing above the range is pooled, and how the premium above the top is drawn.

news_lr._about: Likelihood ratios for 'prices above the range' versus not, per distinct headline, by source tier; the product is capped.

trading._about: Mixture weights for where ANT trades, and the perp bias corrections (half of the one observed case: SpaceX's perp was 17% above the open and 9% above the first close).

news._about: Which outlets count as tier 1 when reading headlines, and the default book coverage if no headline states one.
